name: Rural Development
description: Rural Development invests and provides resources to rural communities helps drive economic security and prosperity. RD fosters economic development by providing loans, grants, and technical assistance to build critical infrastructure like broadband, water systems, and hospitals. Since 2009, Rural Development has financed nearly 8,000 community facilities projects, helped save or create more than 375,000 rural jobs, aided nearly 75,000 rural businesses, improved rural electric infrastructure for more than 25 million rural residents, and supported more than 5,500 distance learning and telemedicine projects.
